edit.description.md:
Fold ~/.local/state/aphotic/agent-events.jsonl into a durable per-project memory (failures, notes, issues) with a workspace plane, an `aphotic memory` CLI, and digest injection into ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md.

Ships as a new plugin in the aphotic-plugins repo (branch feat/agent-memory), no core change: ui-surface + cli capabilities are already hosted.

add.issue.comment.md:
PR: https://github.com/T-Crypt/aphotic-plugins/pull/48 (draft, base main)

Shipped as one plugin in aphotic-plugins, branch feat/agent-memory, no core change.

What is in it: python/memory_core.py folds ~/.local/state/aphotic/agent-events.jsonl into ~/.local/state/aphotic/agent-memory/store.json (per-project sessions/turns/tool calls/failures, failure signatures with occurrence counts, notes) and writes the deterministic digest to context.md. cli/memory.sh exposes aphotic memory build|projects|errors|notes|note|forget|resolve|reopen|context|stats|inject. qml/MemoryWorkspace.qml is the workspace plane; qml/MemoryService.qml is the state holder, which holds no watch and reaches the engine through `aphotic memory` so the plane and the CLI cannot disagree.

Proof run here: pytest 18 passed; test_memory_cli.sh, test_manifest.sh, test_memory_service.sh (offscreen probe) all PASS; aphotic plugin validate -> [ ok ] valid (0 warning(s)); live smoke with install --link, the command against the real event log (610 tool calls, 8 sessions), the injection trio against the real ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (second enable byte-identical, disable restored all 144 lines), then disable/enable/remove clean.

Not verified: the plane's visuals. The Aphotic shell is not running on this machine, so SUPER+SHIFT+W could not be pressed. The plane was instead instantiated offscreen with an empty and with a populated store and every binding resolved (this caught one null-deref in the middle column header).

One deliberate deviation from the ticket text: the digest carries a failure's normalised message (paths, numbers and hex runs collapsed) while `aphotic memory errors` and the plane carry the recorded message, and open_issues counts every unresolved signature rather than only those seen three or more times, so the digest header and stats mean the same thing.
